name: Infosys
capabilities: Integrated services for chip design-to-manufacturing lifecycle
india_angle: Infosys, being an Indian multinational corporation, has a significant presence in India with a focus on leveraging local talent for global semiconductor design and services.
summary: Infosys provides design services to semiconductor manufacturers and fabless companies, focusing on cloud and AI-driven strategies. Their integrated services help navigate the entire chip design-to-manufacturing lifecycle, aiming to improve turnaround times and sustainability.
